# anthropic_federation_rule (Data Source)

Get a single federation rule (`fdrl_…`) by ID. Requires the provider's `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_federation_rule" "example" {
  id = "fdrl_xxxxx"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) ID of the federation rule (`fdrl_…`).

### Read-Only

- `applies_to_all_workspaces` (Boolean) Whether the rule applies to all workspaces.
- `archived_at` (String) RFC 3339 archive datetime, or null if active.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation datetime.
- `issuer_id` (String) ID of the issuer the rule applies to.
- `match` (Attributes) Conditions an incoming JWT must satisfy. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--match))
- `name` (String) Name of the rule.
- `oauth_scope` (String) OAuth scope granted on minted tokens.
- `target` (Attributes) The service account a matched JWT maps to. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--target))
- `token_lifetime_seconds` (Number) Minted token lifetime in seconds.
- `workspace_id` (String) Not returned by the API; always null on reads.

<a id="nestedatt--match"></a>
### Nested Schema for `match`

Read-Only:

- `audience` (String) Required `aud` claim.
- `claims` (Map of String) Exact claim values required.
- `condition` (String) CEL match expression.
- `subject_prefix` (String) Match on the `sub` claim.


<a id="nestedatt--target"></a>
### Nested Schema for `target`

Read-Only:

- `service_account_id` (String) Target service account ID (`svac_…`).
- `type` (String) Target type.
